summary_en: On November 11, 2026, Matsui Construction announced the execution of a block buyback of up to 300,000 shares (1.05% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 1,705 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 12, 2026, for a maximum amount of 550 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Matsui Construction's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company executed a single-day block buyback on November 12, 2026, at the closing price of 1,705 yen established on November 11. The purchase is limited to a maximum of 300,000 shares, representing 1.05% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026: 28,520,861 shares), with a maximum expenditure of 550 million yen. The buy order is valid only during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading window at 8:45 a.m. The company stated that market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the authorized purchase.

The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency further. Results of the execution are to be announced after the completion of trading on November 12, 2026.
